improved_commit_message: Refactor getTransitivePredecessors methods to internal implementation and add caching.
change_summary: This refactoring involves renaming the public method getTransitivePredecessors() to protected getTransitivePredecessorsInternal() across multiple classes in the Flink API. The public method now serves as a wrapper that utilizes a caching mechanism to optimize the retrieval of transitive predecessors. This change enhances performance by reducing repeated computations for previously fetched results, while also better encapsulating the internal logic of the transformation classes.
